articles.headline: Champions Cup match delayed after parachutist stuck on roof
articles.description: A Champions Cup rugby game between Toulouse and Sale was delayed for about half an hour on Sunday when a parachutist in a pre-match display was caught on the roof of the Stadium de Toulouse.

articles.headline: Toulouse win Champions Cup in thrilling final against Leinster
articles.description: Toulouse won a record-extending sixth European Champions Cup when a Matthis Lebel try helped them beat Leinster 31-22 after extra-time on Saturday.

articles.headline: Rugby Club World Cup set to be launched in 2028 - sources
articles.description: Plans for a rugby Club World Cup where the best northern and southern hemisphere club sides will compete against each other are in the offing, sources have told ESPN, with the tournament set to launch in 2028.

articles.headline: La Rochelle edge Leinster again to win back-to-back European crowns
articles.description: La Rochelle became the fifth team to win back-to-back European Champions Cups on Saturday when they clawed back a 17-point deficit to beat Leinster 27-26 at the Aviva Stadium in another breathless final between the sides.

images.name: The La Rochelle team celebrate after lifting the Champions Cup [1296x518]
images.caption: The La Rochelle team celebrate after lifting the Champions Cup

images.name: Nawaqanitawase claims double as Tahs overcome brave Drua
images.caption: Having just inked a new deal with Rugby Australia and the NSW Waratahs, winger Mark Nawaqanitawase scored a double to help his side overcome a brave showing from the Fijian Drua.

articles.headline: Campo's call: Koroibete can get better still, Suaalii approach sends wrong message
articles.description: Wallabies great David Campese says Marika Koroibete is yet to hit the ceiling of his rugby talents, but the man who made the gold No. 11 jersey famous is displeased by talk Rugby Australia is lining up a mega-rich offer to teen sensation Joseph Suaali'i.
